data.title: Ethereum ETFs Have Lost $1.1 Billion in Three Weeks. What Would Bring Buyers Back?
data.description: Billions have fled Ethereum ETFs in weeks, dragging Coinbase stock down with them, and a delayed network upgrade is making things worse. A few specific catalysts could flip the trend, but investors are watching closely for the first sign.
